title: Large-window models get every MCP tool's full schema, chosen from a fixed cost constant
observed: budget.StrategyForWindow picks full-schemas whenever a fixed 31,897-token estimate fits 20% of the window, never measuring the real catalog. With 165 MCP tools (81 Grafana) the first request cache-wrote 74,395 tokens ($0.46), and the kiln run cost $8.51 vs Claude Code's $2.70 for the same spec and model.
expected: The strategy is chosen from the actual catalog size (or defers MCP schemas behind tool_search by default, as Claude Code does).

fix.note: Verified in the kiln-3 CRUD-trial rerun: 7.9 min, 0 prompts, $1.96 (Claude Code $2.70), 34/34 grade.
